facts.text: The hotel is in the centre of Tel Aviv's promenade, facing the beach, between the Marina and Jaffa.
facts.excerpt: is prominently located in the centre of Tel Aviv's promenade, facing the Tel Aviv Beach, between the Marina and Jaffa, with vast views of the Mediterranean Sea.

facts.text: The hotel is 35 minutes (14 km) from Ben Gurion Airport.
facts.excerpt: Just 35 minutes (14 km) from Ben Gurion Airport

facts.text: The hotel is on HaYarkon Street with direct access to the boardwalk and the sea.
facts.excerpt: Ideally located on beachfront HaYarkon Street, guests will enjoy direct access to the boardwalk and the sea

facts.text: Rothschild Boulevard, Carmel Market, Dizengoff Square, the Bauhaus Museum, Neve Tzedek and Old Jaffa are a short walk or quick ride from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is a short walk or quick ride from main city attractions: Rothschild Boulevard, Carmel Market, Dizengoff Square, the Bauhaus Museum, Neve Tzedek, and Old Jaffa.

facts.text: The hotel has kosher dining experiences, including a cocktail lounge and cigar bar.
facts.excerpt: kosher dining experiences, including a cocktail lounge and cigar bar

facts.text: The hotel has a swimming pool, a spa and an events space for corporate and social gatherings.
facts.excerpt: a swimming pool, a luxurious spa and an extensive events space for corporate and social gatherings

facts.text: The Horizon Lounge is a private lounge upstairs for guests to work, relax or eat while enjoying views of the Mediterranean coast.
facts.excerpt: an exclusive space for guests to work, relax or eat while enjoying striking views of the Mediterranean coast

facts.text: Only select rooms include Horizon Lounge access.
facts.excerpt: only select rooms in the hotel include this perk

facts.text: Even the most affordable rooms have at least a partial ocean view.
facts.excerpt: most affordable rooms have at least a partial-ocean view

facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows instead of balconies; the windows open with a stationary glass panel.
facts.excerpt: In place of balconies in each room, the hotel opted to provide more square footage with floor-to-ceiling windows, which still open up with a stationary glass panel.

facts.text: The David Penthouse is a three-floor, two-bedroom penthouse with a private gym and infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: the three-floor, two-bedroom David Penthouse with a private gym and infinity pool

facts.text: The hotel is fully Kosher certified.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is also fully Kosher certified

facts.text: Breakfast is served in the restaurant or outdoors on the deck with a beach view.
facts.excerpt: options to sit inside the light-flooded restaurant or outdoors on the deck to kick the day off with people-watching and an exquisite beach view

facts.text: Underground parking is available to hotel guests subject to availability, with no advance reservations; valet parking is not offered.
facts.excerpt: Underground parking** at the hotel is available for the hotel guests (subject to availability; no advance reservations)
Please note that valet parking is not offered at our hotel.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards 2025 and 2026.
Reviewer calls the infinity pool superb.
facts.excerpt: do not miss the hotel’s superb infinity pool
